name: duopore-public-exam-grade-target
description: Work out the score you need on the work left to reach your final grade target.
keywords: work out the score you need

interface.shortDescription: Work out the score you need
interface.longDescription: Work out the score you need on the work left to reach your final grade target. Enter completed marks, their weights and your goal. See the same score needed across the remaining weight, or a warning if the goal cannot be reached by the maths. For adults checking their own marks. Confirm your school's grading rules; the tool does not predict your exam result.
capabilities: Work out the score you need
defaultPrompt: What score do I need on the work left to reach my grade goal?
Check whether my final grade target is mathematically possible.
